QuestInfo.name: Knighthood Exam: Night Walker
QuestInfo.0: According to #p1101002#, you can take your Knighthood Exam if you go see #b#p1101006##k, the Chief Knight of Darkness. Better head over to Ereve and meet #p1101006#.
QuestInfo.1: The Knighthood Exam has started. The test itself is actually quite simple. You just need to reach the end of the Training Forest, enter #bthe 2nd Drill Hall#k, and defeat the Mimis inside while bringing back #t4032099#. Better find #b30 #t4032099#s#k and bring them back to #p1101006#. \n\n#i4032099# #t4032099# #b#c4032099# / 30#k
QuestInfo.2: You have successfully completed the Knighthood Exam and officially dropped the 'in-Training' from your title. As a bona fide Cygnus Knight, do your best to work hard so you will never be ashamed of yourself.

0.0: Knighthood Exam? Is it already that time? Come to think of it... you have been working for the Cygnus Knights for quite some time... Okay, I will give you the opportunity to take the Knighthood Exam right now. Are you ready?

yes.0: The test is really nothing special. Go to the end of Training Forest and enter #bthe 2nd Drill Hall#k, where you'll find some Mimis inside. Defeat them all and bring back #b30 #t4032099#s#k with you.
yes.1: If you can bring all the #t4032099#s back, then I will grant you the right to become a Knight. At this point, I need your skills to do the talking.

no.0: It doesn't matter when you start, but delaying the inevitable doesn't change a single thing.

item.0: You still haven't brought back #b30 #t4032099#s#k yet. I thought I told you to find them at the end of Training Forest, inside #bthe 2nd Drill Hall#k... Don't you remember this?
